data.name: Battle 3D - Strategy game
data.detailed_description:
Command massive battles with a large number of military units.

You can control all units from above or individually control a selected unit.

Defend your industrial zones and conquer enemy factories to produce more units.

A comprehensive mission editor is available where you can design your own battles, selecting the number of tanks, terrain type...

Now also with a terrain editor to further customize battles by creating your own hills, plateaus, cliffs, forests, cities, and more.

You can also add units mid-battle in missions created with the mission editor.

DLC adds all kinds of military units: soldiers, jeeps, tanks, artillery, helicopters, airplanes, drones, warships, atomic bombs, troop transports by land, sea, and air, and more.

Battle 3D is a highly addictive game; you won't be able to stop playing, moving your tanks, conquering factories, or surrounding enemy armies.

Enjoy the great battles of Battle 3D now!
